title: Add unit tests for `LinkButton`

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Contributes to #43440

Adds unit tests for `LinkButton` covering:

* Defaults: empty text and URI, `UNDERLINE_MODE_ALWAYS`, `TEXT_DIRECTION_AUTO`, empty language, `OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING`, default structured-text BiDi parser and empty options, plus constructor overrides for `FOCUS_ACCESSIBILITY` and `CURSOR_POINTING_HAND`
* `LinkButton(text)` constructor argument
* Text and URI round-trips with idempotent re-set (early-return path) and empty-string clear
* All three `UnderlineMode` enum values plus same-value no-op
* All four valid `TextDirection` values plus out-of-range rejection guard (`ERR_PRINT_OFF`-wrapped)
* Language round-trip and clear
* Ellipsis char round-trip and multi-character clamping to the first character (`WARN_PRINT` suppressed via `ERR_PRINT_OFF`)
* Structured-text BiDi override parser and options round-trips, including same-parser no-op and reset to defaults
* Overrun behavior interaction with `get_combined_minimum_size()`: `OVERRUN_TRIM_CHAR` and `OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD` force width to zero, and restoring `OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING` removes the override (reversibility)
* `get_cursor_shape()` returns `CURSOR_POINTING_HAND` when enabled and `CURSOR_ARROW` when disabled

The minimum-size case asserts only the font-independent branch of `LinkButton::get_minimum_size()` (the unconditional `width = 0` override under overrun trimming) so the test passes on stripped builds with no default font, including the Linux Minimal template CI job.

Fork CI: workflow tests completed successfully on [`calbebop/godot`](https://github.com/calbebop/godot) for branch `add-link-button-unit-tests`.

AI disclosure: I designed the test plan, wrote and reviewed the changes, and validated style and behavior against `LinkButton` in-tree. Cursor helped with research and drafting.
